title: LeKraft Totems
description: Totems in the form of the Ancient from the Altervelt!
body:

This resourcepack change texture for Totems of Undying _using Optifine's **CIT** feature_. For correct work **_you must have_** **Optifine** or **CIT Resewn** installed.
_Made for LeKraft - server with lore, which is made by Lekhey._
